title: Kings @ Grizzlies — Courtney Lee buzzer-beater stands; Sacramento protest denied (Nov 13-28, 2014)
incident_summary: With Sacramento leading 110-109 and 0.3 seconds left, Memphis inbounded via Vince Carter; Marc Gasol screened two Kings defenders and Courtney Lee scored a reverse layup at the horn for a 111-110 Grizzlies win. Sacramento protested that (a) center Ryan Hollins tipped the inbounds pass, which should have started the clock earlier, and (b) Lee's shot did not leave his hands before the buzzer. Commissioner Adam Silver denied the protest on Nov 28, 2014, finding the referees acted within their proper judgment and that no misapplication of the rules occurred. The basket and the 111-110 final stand.
